title: OSB and other wood structural panels: Performance Category and sheet size

citation.standard: Voluntary Product Standard PS 2-18, Performance Standard for Wood Structural Panels (effective 30 March 2019)
citation.publisher: U.S. Department of Commerce / National Institute of Standards and Technology; published by APA - The Engineered Wood Association, Form No. S350H
citation.where: §5.2.1.2 and Table 1, "Panel thickness requirements", page 7, which give each Performance Category its minimum and maximum thickness (Appendix D Table D1 repeats them with the recommended thickness label); §5.2.1.1, which allows plus or minus 1.6 mm (1/16 in) on the manufactured length and width; and §5.3.1.1, page 8, whose structural tests use a minimum test panel size of 1,220 mm x 2,440 mm (48 in. x 96 in.). (Corrected 2026-09-24 for #98: this previously cited §7.3, which is the wall racking test on 8 ft x 8 ft specimens.)

entries.name: 3/8 osb
entries.derivation: Table 1, 3/8 PERF CAT: 8.73 to 10.32 mm (0.344 to 0.406 in). Those limits are rounded conversions of millimetre values and do not land on the 1/1024 in grid, so the exact length carried is the Performance Category itself, 3/8 in. Sheet size: the 48 in x 96 in panel §5.3.1.1 tests, within the plus or minus 1/16 in size tolerance of §5.2.1.1.

entries.name: 7/16 osb
entries.derivation: Table 1, 7/16 PERF CAT: 10.32 to 11.91 mm (0.406 to 0.469 in). Carried length is the category, 7/16 in. Sheet size as above.

entries.name: 15/32 osb
entries.derivation: Table 1, 15/32 PERF CAT: 11.11 to 12.70 mm (0.438 to 0.500 in). Carried length is the category, 15/32 in. Sheet size as above.

entries.name: 19/32 osb
entries.derivation: Table 1, 19/32 PERF CAT: 14.29 to 15.88 mm (0.563 to 0.625 in). Carried length is the category, 19/32 in. Sheet size as above.

entries.name: 23/32 osb
entries.derivation: Table 1, 23/32 PERF CAT: 17.46 to 19.05 mm (0.688 to 0.750 in). Carried length is the category, 23/32 in. PS 2-18 lists 23/32 and 3/4 as two separate Performance Categories; neither is stated to be the actual thickness of the other. Sheet size as above.

entries.name: 3/4 osb
entries.derivation: Table 1, 3/4 PERF CAT: 18.26 to 19.84 mm (0.719 to 0.781 in). Carried length is the category, 3/4 in. Sheet size as above.

entries.name: 1-1/8 osb
entries.derivation: Table 1, 1-1/8 PERF CAT: 27.15 to 30.00 mm (1.069 to 1.181 in). Carried length is the category, 1-1/8 in. Sheet size as above.
